newsitem.title: CHINA: Earthquake rocks remote northwest China province.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake rocks remote northwest China province.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.0 on the Richter scale rocked China's remote northwestern Qinghai province on Friday, the Xinhua news agency said.
Officials said there were no reports of damage from the tremor.
The earthquake hit Maduonan in sparsely populated Qinghai province at 1.28 a.m. (1628 GMT Thursday), Xinhua quoted the State Seismological Bureau, as saying.
The bureau gave the epicentre at 34.8 degrees north latitude and 98.1 degrees east longitude.
